_readme: Answer key. Fill in each value from the PDF; leave null if the contract does not state it (or it is redacted, and add a note). page is optional. Set status to "done" when finished, then run: pnpm --filter @cea/agent check-labels

documentType._hint: One of: supply_agreement, msa, sow, amendment, order_form

customerName._hint: Legal name of the buyer, as written, e.g. "Lannett Company, Inc."

vendorName._hint: Legal name of the seller (supplier or manufacturer), as written

effectiveDate._hint: YYYY-MM-DD. If effective on last signature, use that signature date

expirationDate._hint: YYYY-MM-DD, only if a date is stated. A duration alone ("5 years") means null

priceEscalation._hint: Short phrase, e.g. "PPI-based, capped at 4% a year"

paymentTermsDays._hint: Number of net days, e.g. 45 (no quotes)

minimumCommitment._hint: Short phrase, e.g. "At least 80% of requirements"

poAcceptance._hint: Example: { "days": 5, "dayType": "business", "ifNoResponse": "accepted" }. dayType: business | calendar. ifNoResponse: accepted | rejected | not_stated

priceList._hint: Array of rows, e.g. [ { "item": "Posaconazole DR tablets 100 mg", "unitPrice": 310.00, "currency": "USD", "unitOfMeasure": "pack of 60" } ]
